consequence.statement: Clusters not deployed via Flux Operator must run `flux migrate` before upgrading, because the v1beta1 and v2beta1 APIs have been removed from the CRDs.
consequence.remediation: Run `flux migrate` on the cluster before upgrading to Flux 2.7; see the Flux v2.7 upgrade guide.

assertion.statement: Flux APIs v1beta1 and v2beta1 were removed from the CRDs; unless Flux Operator deploys the controllers, `flux migrate` must be run on clusters before upgrading to 2.7.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The text does not name the affected kinds or say how to detect use of v1beta1/v2beta1 resources, so exposure cannot be expressed as a predicate.
